The Convention · programme

The Annual Convention

The Federation's annual gathering, held since 1959: governance, the election and the Assembly floor, the banquet, youth events and every programme's moment. It sits on no branch and is reachable from all of them.

The junction. Once a year every branch meets at the Convention: the governance floor, programme gatherings and the community. It belongs to no branch and is a rung on none.

Who it's for

AFRP members; membership is mandatory for every attendee, and non-members pay dues with registration. Voting needs dues received by 30 April and certification.

The operating year

A city bids at the Mid-Year two years ahead. Magazine notice at least 60 days before. Dues by 30 April for the vote. Convention in July. Host's final accounting within 120 days.

The five rungs

RungFor this programme
HearThe magazine notice at least 60 days ahead (By-Law 10.1.4), a statutory duty; digital notice is added, never substituted.
Show upRegistering and attending; voting is separate, and the 30 April franchise cliff is surfaced in March.
Take partThe delegation: weighted voting, from which any certified member may extract their own vote.
Give or serveThe host committee and desk volunteers, handling three kinds of money correctly.
LeadThe bid, two years out: a host club that bids, hosts and closes the books.

Who runs it

The host club's convention committee with the Federation. A host needs 50 paid members for five consecutive years; it files a final accounting within 120 days.

Money

Platform-collected registration and Relief Fund gifts are Federation money from the first dollar. Off-platform receipts are receivables due at settlement; the host's own hafli is club money until remitted.

Hand-offs

The junction: every branch leads here and none owns it. The RBPN mixer, Medical Mission report, Women to Women fundraising, award announcements and the alumni event happen here.
